SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

alter PROC [BNKM].[SP_INDIVIDUALCUSTOMER_CRM] AS
BEGIN

WITH TEMP_BNKM_IndividualCustomer AS 
(
	SELECT distinct
		BCA.ORGKEY AS CustomerId
		,BCA.NAME AS IndividualCustomerName
		,BCA.CUST_DOB AS DateOfBirth
		,BCA.DATEOFDEATH AS DateOfDeath
		,NULL AS SexId
		,BCA.GENDER AS GenderId
		,BCD.ETHINICITY AS EthnicCategoryId
		,BCD.RACE AS RacialCategoryId
		,BCA.PREFERREDNAME AS PreferredName
		,BCA.SHORT_NAME AS ShortName
		,BCA.SALUTATION AS NamePrefix
		,BCA.CUST_FIRST_NAME AS FirstName
		,BCA.CUST_MIDDLE_NAME AS MiddleName
		,BCA.CUST_LAST_NAME AS LastName
		,BCA.NAMESUFFIX AS NameSuffix
		,BCA.STRUSERFIELD1 AS BirthPlaceCountry
		,BCA.PLACEOFBIRTH AS BirthPlaceCity
		,BCA.CUSTOMERNREFLG AS NonResidentIndicator
		,BCA.MAIDENNAMEOFMOTHER AS MothersMaidenName
		,BCA.STAFFFLAG AS EmployeeIndicator
		,BCA.INSIDERTOBANK AS Dosri
		,BCA.INSIDERROLE AS DosriTypeId
		,BCA.CUSTOMERMINOR AS MinorIndicator
		,BCA.SEGMENTATION_CLASS AS Segment
		,BCA.STRUSERFIELD22 AS RelatedPartyIndicator
		,BCA.STRUSERFIELD23 AS RelatedPartyTypeId
		,BCD.USERFIELD5 AS FATCAIndicator
		,BCD.USERFIELD6 AS FATCATypeId
        ,'CRM' AS SourceCode
        ,BCA.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
	FROM  BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS BCA 
	LEFT JOIN BUSC.CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC BCD  ON BCD.ORGKEY = BCA.ORGKEY  AND BCD.isLatest = 1
	where  BCD.ACCOUNTID <> 0  and BCA.islatest = 1 

	

)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_IndividualCustomer FROM TEMP_BNKM_IndividualCustomer;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_IndividualCustomer_SRC AS
(
	SELECT 
		HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
			convert(varchar,CustomerId)
			,convert(varchar,IndividualCustomerName)
			,convert(date,DateOfBirth)
			,convert(date,DateOfDeath)
			,convert(varchar,replace(SexId,' ',''))
			,convert(varchar,replace(GenderId,' ',''))
			,convert(varchar,replace(EthnicCategoryId,' ',''))
			,convert(varchar,replace(RacialCategoryId,' ',''))
			,convert(varchar,replace(PreferredName,' ',''))
			,convert(varchar,replace(ShortName,' ',''))
			,convert(varchar,replace(NamePrefix,' ',''))
			,convert(varchar,replace(FirstName,' ',''))
			,convert(varchar,replace(MiddleName,' ',''))
			,convert(varchar,replace(LastName,' ',''))
			,convert(varchar,replace(NameSuffix,' ',''))
			,convert(varchar,replace(BirthPlaceCountry,' ',''))
			,convert(varchar,replace(BirthPlaceCity,' ',''))
			,convert(varchar,replace(NonResidentIndicator,' ',''))
			,convert(varchar,replace(MothersMaidenName,' ',''))
			,convert(varchar,replace(EmployeeIndicator,' ',''))
			,convert(varchar,replace(Dosri,' ',''))
			,convert(varchar,replace(DosriTypeId,' ',''))
			,convert(varchar,replace(MinorIndicator,' ',''))
			,convert(varchar,replace(Segment,' ',''))
			,convert(varchar,replace(RelatedPartyIndicator,' ',''))
			,convert(varchar,replace(RelatedPartyTypeId,' ',''))
			,convert(varchar,replace(FATCAIndicator,' ',''))
			,convert(varchar,replace(FATCATypeId,' ',''))
			,convert(varchar,replace(SourceCode,' ',''))
			)) HASHROW
			,FinancialInstitutionId ,CustomerId, SourceCode
	FROM #TEMP_BNKM_IndividualCustomer
)

,TEMP_BNKM_IndividualCustomer_TGT AS
(
	SELECT 
		HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
			convert(varchar,CustomerId)
			,convert(varchar,IndividualCustomerName)
			,convert(date,DateOfBirth)
			,convert(date,DateOfDeath)
			,convert(varchar,replace(SexId,' ',''))
			,convert(varchar,replace(GenderId,' ',''))
			,convert(varchar,replace(EthnicCategoryId,' ',''))
			,convert(varchar,replace(RacialCategoryId,' ',''))
			,convert(varchar,replace(PreferredName,' ',''))
			,convert(varchar,replace(ShortName,' ',''))
			,convert(varchar,replace(NamePrefix,' ',''))
			,convert(varchar,replace(FirstName,' ',''))
			,convert(varchar,replace(MiddleName,' ',''))
			,convert(varchar,replace(LastName,' ',''))
			,convert(varchar,replace(NameSuffix,' ',''))
			,convert(varchar,replace(BirthPlaceCountry,' ',''))
			,convert(varchar,replace(BirthPlaceCity,' ',''))
			,convert(varchar,replace(NonResidentIndicator,' ',''))
			,convert(varchar,replace(MothersMaidenName,' ',''))
			,convert(varchar,replace(EmployeeIndicator,' ',''))
			,convert(varchar,replace(Dosri,' ',''))
			,convert(varchar,replace(DosriTypeId,' ',''))
			,convert(varchar,replace(MinorIndicator,' ',''))
			,convert(varchar,replace(Segment,' ',''))
			,convert(varchar,replace(RelatedPartyIndicator,' ',''))
			,convert(varchar,replace(RelatedPartyTypeId,' ',''))
			,convert(varchar,replace(FATCAIndicator,' ',''))
			,convert(varchar,replace(FATCATypeId,' ',''))
			,convert(varchar,replace(SourceCode,' ',''))
			)) HASHROW
			,FinancialInstitutionId ,CustomerId, SourceCode
	FROM BNKM.IndividualCustomer
	WHERE SourceCode = 'CRM' 
)

,TEMP_BNKM_IndividualCustomer_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
	,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,ISNULL(SRC.SourceCode,TGT.SourceCode) AS SourceCode
	,CASE 
	WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'  
	WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE' ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
FROM TEMP_BNKM_IndividualCustomer_SRC	SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_IndividualCustomer_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SourceCode = TGT.SourceCode
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_IndividualCustomer_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_IndividualCustomer_DELTA;


UPDATE TGT
SET
	IndividualCustomerName = SRC.IndividualCustomerName
	,DateOfBirth = SRC.DateOfBirth
	,DateOfDeath = SRC.DateOfDeath
	,SexId = SRC.SexId
	,GenderId = SRC.GenderId
	,EthnicCategoryId = SRC.EthnicCategoryId
	,RacialCategoryId = SRC.RacialCategoryId
	,PreferredName = SRC.PreferredName
	,ShortName = SRC.ShortName
	,NamePrefix = SRC.NamePrefix
	,FirstName = SRC.FirstName
	,MiddleName = SRC.MiddleName
	,LastName = SRC.LastName
	,NameSuffix = SRC.NameSuffix
	,BirthPlaceCountry = SRC.BirthPlaceCountry
	,BirthPlaceCity = SRC.BirthPlaceCity
	,NonResidentIndicator = SRC.NonResidentIndicator
	,MothersMaidenName = SRC.MothersMaidenName
	,EmployeeIndicator = SRC.EmployeeIndicator
	,Dosri = SRC.Dosri
	,DosriTypeId = SRC.DosriTypeId
	,MinorIndicator = SRC.MinorIndicator
	,Segment = SRC.Segment
	,RelatedPartyIndicator = SRC.RelatedPartyIndicator
	,RelatedPartyTypeId = SRC.RelatedPartyTypeId
	,FATCAIndicator = SRC.FATCAIndicator
	,FATCATypeId = SRC.FATCATypeId
FROM BNKM.IndividualCustomer TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_IndividualCustomer_DELTA DELTA
	ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
	AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
	AND DELTA.SourceCode = TGT.SourceCode
	AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_IndividualCustomer SRC
	ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
	AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
	AND SRC.SourceCode = TGT.SourceCode
	;



INSERT INTO BNKM.IndividualCustomer 
(CustomerId ,IndividualCustomerName ,DateOfBirth ,DateOfDeath ,SexId ,GenderId ,EthnicCategoryId ,RacialCategoryId ,PreferredName ,ShortName ,NamePrefix
,FirstName ,MiddleName ,LastName ,NameSuffix ,BirthPlaceCountry ,BirthPlaceCity ,NonResidentIndicator ,MothersMaidenName ,EmployeeIndicator ,Dosri ,DosriTypeId
,MinorIndicator ,Segment ,RelatedPartyIndicator ,RelatedPartyTypeId ,FATCAIndicator ,FATCATypeId ,SourceCode ,FinancialInstitutionId)

SELECT 
     SRC.CustomerId
    ,SRC.IndividualCustomerName
    ,SRC.DateOfBirth
    ,SRC.DateOfDeath
    ,SRC.SexId
    ,SRC.GenderId
    ,SRC.EthnicCategoryId
    ,SRC.RacialCategoryId
    ,SRC.PreferredName
    ,SRC.ShortName
    ,SRC.NamePrefix
    ,SRC.FirstName
    ,SRC.MiddleName
    ,SRC.LastName
    ,SRC.NameSuffix
    ,SRC.BirthPlaceCountry
    ,SRC.BirthPlaceCity
    ,SRC.NonResidentIndicator
    ,SRC.MothersMaidenName
    ,SRC.EmployeeIndicator
    ,SRC.Dosri
    ,SRC.DosriTypeId
    ,SRC.MinorIndicator
    ,SRC.Segment
    ,SRC.RelatedPartyIndicator
    ,SRC.RelatedPartyTypeId
    ,SRC.FATCAIndicator
    ,SRC.FATCATypeId
    ,SRC.SourceCode
    ,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_IndividualCustomer SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_IndividualCustomer_DELTA DELTA
	ON DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId
	AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
	AND DELTA.SourceCode = SRC.SourceCode
WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'INSERT'

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_IndividualCustomer;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_IndividualCustomer_DELTA;

END

GO
